Title: Diagnosis of test `testGenerateURLFragment`
Details: The test `testGenerateURLFragment` checks whether HTML entities such as `"` are correctly escaped to their corresponding character by the `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` method. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Following the execution path, we find that `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` is not escaping any HTML code; instead, it is using its input `toolTipText` as is. Consequently, un-escaped strings are being returned, which leads to the error demonstrated by the test.

After providing this diagnosis, you will be prompted to suggest which methods would be the best locations to be fixed. The failing test tests the method `getBytesWritten()` of `TarArchiveOutputStream` (presumably) by asserting that the file length matches the number of bytes written according to the stream. The failure shows the expected length of the file was 10240 but the returned bytes written was only 76, indicating `getBytesWritten()` likely returns an incorrect count.

To diagnose more specifically, I will look into the `getBytesWritten()` method in `TarArchiveOutputStream` first to see the implementation details around the byte counting. I will call to get the code snippet of `TarArchiveOutputStream.getBytesWritten()`.
